title: &6The Ember Forge
subtitle: Six alloys, four seals. Nothing is handed to you twice.

quests.title: &6The Ember Forge
quests.subtitle: What the Smith knows, and the Keeper won't say.
description: Everything worth building under the black sun is built from &6Ember alloys&r: six of them, one for each part of the road. A Sophisticated chest, an OmniVault terminal, a diamond blade, a Sovereign's sigil: they all ask for the alloy of the act they belong to.

&6Ashen Alloy&r comes first. After that, every alloy needs a &6Seal&r, bound once from the relics of the Sovereigns that closed the act before. The seal is never used up: it stays in the crafting grid every time you forge.
&7A Sovereign leaves one relic. Trade it at a shrine for its armament, or bind it into a seal. Its sigil will call it back if you want both.

&7The Forge reaches every workshop in Last Light. The Works' machine frames are Ashen Alloy; the vaults' processors think with the Works' circuits; Chronofall's charger is built on the Works' generator; and every Sovereign after the Rider wants an &6offering&7 made in one of them. Nothing you learn in one chapter is wasted in the next.

quests.title: &7I. &fAshen Alloy
quests.subtitle: Iron, andesite and a rune, stirred.
description: Put two &6iron ingots&r, two &6andesite alloy&r and a &6Faded Rune&r in a Create &6Basin&r under a &6Mechanical Mixer&r. Three Ashen Alloy come out.
Ashen Alloy is what the pack's iron used to be: Sophisticated chests and backpacks, every upgrade base, OmniVault's frames, iron wands and the Dusk Rider's sigil all want it.
&7Faded Runes drop from common loot bags. Don't spend every one at the shrine.

quests.title: &eThe Seal of Dusk
quests.subtitle: One relic, bound for good.
description: The Dusk Rider's &6relic&r in the centre, four &6Sovereign Fragments&r in the corners, four &6Ashen Alloy&r around it.
The seal opens Act II: Varghast's and Sylvara's sigils need it in the grid, and so does every Duskforged Ingot.
&7What you are binding is the Rider's stopped minute. While it sat in his clock the nights could not turn. In your seal they can, and the first thing to turn is the moon: Act II.

quests.title: &7II. &6Duskforged Ingot
quests.subtitle: Pressed gold, under the evening's seal.
description: Press gold into &6golden sheets&r with a Create &6Mechanical Press&r. Then: four Ashen Alloy, two golden sheets, a &6Remnant Shard&r, a &6Tempering Stone II&r and the Seal of Dusk, which stays. Four ingots.
Duskforged is the pack's gold: gold-tier storage, OmniVault &6Logic Processors&r, the explorer's compass, and every piece of &bdiamond&r gear.

quests.title: &cThe Seal of the Hunt
quests.subtitle: Two crowns and a feast.
description: &6Varghast's&r and &6Sylvara's&r relics, four Sovereign Fragments, two Duskforged Ingots, and a whole &6Roast Chicken&r feast from the Hearth's kitchen in the middle. The Keeper says the old court never sealed anything on an empty stomach.
Opens Act III: Kaelthar's and Ysolde's sigils, and Moonsilver.
&7A king who would not let go and a queen who would not let thaw, bound together. The thaw runs down into the deep, and the deep wakes: Act III.

quests.title: &7III. &bMoonsilver Ingot
quests.subtitle: Cooled under the Hunter's Moon.
description: Two Duskforged Ingots, two &6diamonds&r, three &6amethyst shards&r, a &6Lustrous Stone I&r and the Seal of the Hunt make two &6Moonsilver Blend&r. Blast the blend.
Moonsilver is the pack's diamond: diamond-tier storage, every advanced upgrade, OmniVault's &6Advanced Processor&r (and with it autocrafting and wireless), diamond wands.

quests.title: &3The Seal of the Deep
quests.subtitle: A storm, a garden and a heart that beat in the dark.
description: &6Kaelthar's&r and &6Ysolde's&r relics, the Warden's &6Heart of the Deep&r, two Moonsilver Ingots, three Sovereign Fragments and a &6Flaxen Cheese Wheel&r, aged in a keg.
Opens Act IV: Morgrath's and Vaelorn's sigils, and Deepsteel.
&7Storm, bloom and the heart of the thing that listened. With them bound the sky clears enough to show the ash still rising in the south: Act IV.

quests.title: &7IV. &3Deepsteel Ingot
quests.subtitle: Haunted in soul fire.
description: Four Moonsilver Ingots, a &6Reinforced Echo Shard&r, two &6prismarine crystals&r, a &6Lustrous Stone III&r and the Seal of the Deep make four &6Deepsteel Blend&r.
Then &6haunt&r it: blow the blend through &6soul fire&r with a Create &6Encased Fan&r. Nothing else will turn it.
Deepsteel is the pack's netherite: netherite-tier storage, OmniVault's &6Quantum Processor&r, the top stack upgrades, netherite wands.

quests.title: &6The Seal of Ash
quests.subtitle: A burning crown, a last shore, a star and a dragon's breath.
description: &6Morgrath's&r and &6Vaelorn's&r relics, a &6Nether Star&r, a bottle of &6dragon's breath&r, two Deepsteel Ingots, two Sovereign Fragments and a &6Steak Dinner&r from the garden's kitchen.
Opens the last door: the &5Eclipse Shard&r needs the Seal of Ash in the grid, and so does Sunforged.
&7The last two crowns, the star of the oldest hunger and a breath of the first sun. Seven embers. Only one door is still shut: Act V.

quests.title: &7V. &eSunforged Ingot
quests.subtitle: Melted over a living flame.
description: Four Deepsteel Ingots, a &6netherite ingot&r, two &6blaze powder&r, a &6Lustrous Stone VI&r and the Seal of Ash make four &6Sunforged Blend&r.
Mix each blend with a &6glowstone dust&r in a basin over a &6heated Blaze Burner&r.
Sunforged opens the Eclipsed Realm (the &5Eclipse Shard&r), the Everlasting upgrades, and every stack upgrade past diamond blocks.

quests.title: &7VI. &5Eclipse Core
quests.subtitle: Built around a splinter of the black sun.
description: A Create &6Mechanical Crafting&r recipe, five crafters wide: four &6Sunforged Ingots&r, four &6Grave Iron&r from the Realm's wardens, four &6Royal Soul Fragments&r from its fallen knights, and an &6Eclipse Shard&r at the heart.

The Core is the end of the Forge: OmniVault's singularity cells, quantum bridges and assemblers, the &6omega&r stack upgrades, the infinity wand and the Everlasting and Inception upgrades all need one.

quests.title: &6Every Hand at the Forge
quests.subtitle: Last Light is more than one fire.
description: &6The Keeper&r

&f&o"Three of them finished. The Company's ledger, or the Works, or the vault that thinks, or the garden. It doesn't matter which. What matters is that somebody in this village built something that wasn't a weapon and saw it through.&r
&f&oThe Sovereigns each kept their piece of the sun to themselves. Look around you, Ashborn. This is what it looks like when people don't."&r

Finish any &6three&r of Last Light's crafts (the last quest of the Company, the Works, the Vaults, Chronofall, the Mycelial Court, the Last Coast, the Voices, the Wands, Runeborn, the Ash Garden, the Fractured Archive or the Dungeon Trail) and the village pays it back in the only coin the road ahead takes.
&7Six &6Sovereign Fragments&7: one whole sigil, or a second call to a Sovereign whose relic you spent.
